overview_description.description:
Speko is an artificial intelligence developer tools company that develops a voice AI gateway platform for building and deploying conversational AI agents. The platform provides a unified API that abstracts the entire voice stack, including speech-to-text (STT), large language models (LLMs), and text-to-speech (TTS), and automatically routes requests to the best-performing providers based on latency, accuracy, cost, and language.

Its platform combines voice AI orchestration, provider routing, speech recognition, text-to-speech synthesis, conversational AI, voice-native retrieval, benchmarking, failover, and deployment tools into a single infrastructure layer. Developers can create voice agents using natural language prompts, test them in real time, and deploy them across phone systems, web applications, mobile applications, and APIs without managing multiple provider integrations. Speko also provides SDKs, APIs, benchmarking tools, and monitoring capabilities for building production-grade voice applications.
